rationale_evidence.anchor: Is this axis the same decomposition as step-020's 8 TYPES ... NO — it is a FORK, not a refinement
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-027's U(H) 8-vector (measurement/epistemic/aleatoric/model/semantic/identity/temporal/causal, partitioning uncertainty by causal origin in the pipeline) is an uncited FORK against step-020's 8 TYPES (partitioning the logical/representational shape of an unknown) -- two orthogonal, unreconciled 8-way taxonomies over the same symbol space, plus a third incompatible 5-term U-decomposition (U_D) in the same file 39 sections later.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Contradiction(A,B) iff Context(A)≈Context(B) ∧ A⊨¬B — ILL-TYPED ... FIRST INVALID INFERENCE, §28.44
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-028's conflict/contradiction formalism is load-bearing on an undefined context-similarity relation (Context(A)≈Context(B)); its non-explosion/containment invariant is stipulated, not derived; the file's first invalid inference (§28.44) presupposes a well-defined containment boundary that classical logic with a functionality axiom for Version would not actually respect, requiring an unspecified paraconsistent or relevance-logic mechanism.

rationale_evidence.anchor: A satisfying assignment does not 'may' exist; it demonstrably DOES exist ... §29.24 ... ASSERTED, NOT ARGUED
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-029's worked SAT example ((A∨B)∧(¬A∨C)) is verifier-recomputed to have 4 satisfying models, contradicting the source's hedge 'may exist'; the file's 'no SMT solver needed everywhere' decision criterion is asserted with no complexity claim, no cost model, and no classification procedure for 'simple' vs solver-requiring constraints, while its own companion meta file lists complexity analysis as 'Not yet analyzed'.

rationale_evidence.anchor: STEP 31 ... THE LOAD-BEARING FILE ... TWO ILL-TYPINGS IN ONE LINE ... IS THE UPGRADE EARNED BY ANYTHING IN §31.69? NO
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-031 (the corpus's designated formal audit) is found ILL-TYPED at its own type universe (undeclared P, colliding V symbol, untyped sigma, colliding G=(V,E)); its status upgrade to 'Structurally Sound + Mathematically Coherent at the Core' (§31.70) is ruled unearned on four independent grounds (coherence undefined while the proof calculus is OPEN; no new evidence beyond a mostly oracle-gated/circular counterexample set; the upgrade's own §31.75 'no contradiction' line is refuted by two in-file contradictions VC-1/VC-2; and it reverses the commissioning meta-file's calibrated verdict on no new evidence) -- called a relabelling, not a finding.

rationale_evidence.anchor: CE tally: genuinely derivable ... CE4, CE5, CE13, CE16 (4/20) ... circular ... oracle ... ill-posed ... not actually tested
rationale_evidence.statement: Of step-031's twenty counterexamples CE1-CE20, verifier re-derivation classifies only 4 as genuinely derivable from the file's own §31.1-31.48 definitions (CE4, CE5, CE13, CE16), 4 as circular axiom-restatements, 7 as gated on undefined oracles or silently imported from uncited earlier steps, 1 as ill-posed (vacuous), and 1 (CE11) as not actually tested despite being labelled 'PASS conceptually'.

rationale_evidence.anchor: §32.34 ... immediately self-invalidated at §32.34's own next line ... §32.79 ... a fourth competing spine object
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-032's Status(A) six-value enum is declared and then withdrawn as non-mutually-exclusive within the same section; its EpistemicClaim EC 11-tuple is identified as a fourth competing 'spine' object alongside step-031's 6-tuple assertion, 7-tuple K_t, and its own 5-tuple State(A); its Belnap-FOUR-equivalent lattice claim is neither named nor cited as Belnap's bilattice, and no join/meet operation is ever defined.

rationale_evidence.anchor: §35.24 ... NP-hard in general ... TRUE but UNPROVED ... §35.75's boxed conclusion ... NOT_DERIVED ... FIRST INVALID INFERENCE: §35.75
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-035's portfolio-optimization NP-hardness claim is judged true but unproved (no reduction, no approximation ratio, and its own §35.27 constructs a supermodular case for which the greedy bound explicitly fails); its boxed conclusion that 'the mathematical architecture does not inherently require a supercomputer' is ruled NOT_DERIVED because 3 of the 8 listed operation families (constraint checking/SAT, optimization, Bayesian inference) are precisely the ones already shown intractable two sections earlier.

rationale_evidence.anchor: §36.7 ... verbatim duplicates of step-030 §30.8–30.9, uncited ... The file states the requirement it violates two pages earlier ... §36.49 ... 8-tuple H ... vs §36.80 ... 6-tuple
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-036's calibration/meta-validation layer duplicates step-030's Brier/log-loss formulas uncited, then internally violates its own later-stated requirement (SE and sample size for every meta-metric) with the same undated formulas; it defines two incompatible 'health/meta' vectors (8-tuple H at §36.49 vs 6-tuple MetaState_t at §36.80, VC-7) and boxes a 4-kind drift family that silently omits 4 of the 6 drift kinds it had just enumerated (VC-8).

rationale_evidence.anchor: of the ~50 headline boxes above, the overwhelming majority are negative separations of the form X ≠ Y ... a separation is not a construction
rationale_evidence.statement: Structural observation across ~50 catalogued headline boxed claims from steps 026-040: the dominant rhetorical move is a negative separation 'X != Y' (Unknown!=0.5, Similarity!=Identity, Optimal!=Authorized, etc.), which is cheap to assert/defend and usually correct but is 'not a construction' -- it specifies what not to write, not what to write; only three boxed claims in the scope are positive constructions (EpistemicTypeSafety, evidence-append-vs-belief-revise separation, I*=argmax NVOI), and only the third is fully specified enough to implement.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Boundary test: PARTIALLY_CLEAR — it rests on Meaning(·|·), which is undefined ... §206.16 boundary score: NOT ESTABLISHED — measurement-theoretic defect ... precisely the construction the corpus has repeatedly rejected
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-206's bounded-context boundary test Meaning(x|BC_i)!=Meaning(x|BC_j) is ruled PARTIALLY_CLEAR because Meaning is one of the corpus's already-flagged undefined oracles; its weighted boundary score B(i,j)=sum(w_i D_i) is ruled NOT ESTABLISHED because none of the five divergence components (D_L,D_I,D_C,D_O,D_T) has a declared scale, estimand, or admissible-transformation class -- the same weighted-sum construction the corpus has rejected elsewhere (step-025c-1's scoring rejection, step-019's partial-order-with-Incomparable insistence, step-003's scalar-as-projection doctrine).

rationale_evidence.anchor: §206.18 does raise the alarm ... we must not pretend that d_sem = 0.73 is scientifically meaningful ... But the caught defect is false precision, not scale admissibility. Even a fully validated measurement procedure would not make a weighted sum legitimate
rationale_evidence.statement: Notes a partial self-catch in step-206: it correctly separates formal construct / operational measure / empirical validation and admits only the first exists, but this self-catch addresses false numerical precision, not the deeper measurement-theoretic defect that a weighted sum over unscaled components is illegitimate even once validated -- 'the self-catch is one level short'.

rationale_evidence.anchor: §207.5–207.6 version-pinning ... re-derivation of step-058 ... uncited ... §207.16 ExecutionResult ≠ Outcome ... re-derives step-064 ... §207.25 ... re-derives step-053's SchemaCompatibility ≠ SemanticCompatibility ... §207.43 ... re-derives step-016 T10, step-022 H1/H2, step-048 I3 and step-055 ... §207.36–37 AI_can(x) ⇏ AI_may(x) ... re-derives step-062, step-065, step-053
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-207's five derivation-VALID results are each independently identified as uncited re-derivations of earlier corpus steps (version pinning from step-058/055, ExecutionResult!=Outcome from step-064, schema-vs-semantic compatibility from step-053, historical-validity-at-applicable-time from steps 016/022/048/055, and AI_can(x) not-implies AI_may(x) from steps 062/065/053) -- correct as mathematics, but none crediting its source, extending the corpus-wide re-derivation-without-citation pattern.

rationale_evidence.anchor: I_C (§207.39): a new named invariant, unnumbered, outside step-048's frozen 𝓘 — extending TV-F-029 to the corpus head (now ≥26 such invariants)
rationale_evidence.statement: Step-207's contract invariant I_C=Identity∧Version∧SemanticIntegrity∧Provenance∧TemporalValidity is a new named invariant minted outside step-048's frozen invariant set 𝓘 with no number assigned, extending the previously-registered finding TV-F-029 (unnumbered invariant sprawl) to the corpus head, now counted at 26 or more such invariants.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Step 208's headline question is already answered three times in the corpus ... LocalCorrectness ⇏ GlobalCorrectness ... CorrectContexts ⇏ CorrectComposition ... Attack 50 exhibits a concrete instance ... Register sync: AC C-085
rationale_evidence.statement: TV-F-041: step-207's forward-announced Step 208 (Semantic Contract Algebra) is scoped around a question ('can a chain of individually valid transformations produce an invalid conclusion') already answered affirmatively three times in the corpus (step-048 LocalCorrectness!=GlobalCorrectness, step-058 CorrectContexts!=CorrectComposition, and step-050 Attack 50's concrete counterexample), none of which step-207 cites; the corpus's positive composition claim (step-053's LocalInvariant+ContractInvariant=>GlobalInvariant, with undefined operators oplus/Preserve) stands contradicted by Attack 50 (TV-F-039). Registered as AC C-085; recommends Step 208 instead define the composition operator oplus and Preserve(T_ij,I), the two symbols left undefined since step-048/step-053, rather than re-establishing an already-known result.
